# Lumos

Lumos is the site of full-stack developer Hwemo Chung. Two lines of work: (1) diagnosing and maintaining neglected hybrid mobile apps — Cordova, Ionic, Capacitor, Android WebView — that can no longer ship to the App Store or Google Play, and (2) small native macOS and web utilities. Shared navigation supports Korean, English, and Japanese.

## Services

- Legacy hybrid-app triple-blockade diagnosis (iOS 26 SDK requirement, Play target API, Firebase Dynamic Links shutdown). Free for the first 10 apps: https://hwemo-chung.github.io/cordova.html
- Mobile production retainer — Ionic / Capacitor / Android WebView. Pilot $400 one week, Stabilizer $1,200/month: https://hwemo-chung.github.io/retainer.html
- Services and pricing overview: https://hwemo-chung.github.io/sales/
- Offer catalog: https://hwemo-chung.github.io/offers/

## Products

- HotLauncher — macOS 26 (Tahoe) removed Launchpad; bind up to 20 apps to one global hotkey. Free, open source: https://hwemo-chung.github.io/hot-launcher.html (English: ?lang=en)
- LumosZipForMac — AES-256 password-protected ZIP for macOS, universal native app: https://hwemo-chung.github.io/lumoszip.html
- Pebblez — quiet social PWA, no ads or recommendation algorithm: https://pebblez.teagarden-earlgrey.workers.dev
- Burnline — local-first AI cost control (in development): https://hwemo-chung.github.io/burnline.html

## Free tools

- Threads analyzer (browser-only, no upload): https://hwemo-chung.github.io/threads-analyzer.html
- Color picker: https://hwemo-chung.github.io/color-picker.html
- Micro SaaS experiments: https://hwemo-chung.github.io/micro-saas-mvps/

## Machine-readable catalog

- Offer catalog feed (42 items, JSON): https://hwemo-chung.github.io/offers/products.json
- Field map: `id` → page `https://hwemo-chung.github.io/offers/{id}.html` · `price_min`/`price_max`/`price_currency` → price band · `delivery` → lead time in Korean business days · `needs` → what the buyer must supply before work starts · `bullets` → deliverables.
- Every offer page carries schema.org `Service` + `Offer` JSON-LD with the same values; the catalog index at /offers/ carries an `ItemList` of all 42.
- There is no cart or automated checkout. The order action on each offer page is a `mailto:` inquiry to tolaria@naver.com pre-filled with product, URL, and the fields needed for a quote.

## Policies (as published)

- Payment: invoice by email, prepaid. The offer catalog is priced in KRW; the retainer is billed in USD or as agreed. The only public self-serve payment link is LumosZipForMac on Gumroad.
- Retainer: work starts after payment. No mid-week refund once hours are used.
- Free diagnosis: limited to the first 10 apps, status report only — no code changes.
- Scope: audit/report products deliver documents (PDF/Markdown); code changes are quoted separately. Signing and store submission are recommended to stay with the client.
- No refund policy is published for one-off audit products; ask by email before ordering.
